title: Two traders from this community won last time. Season 2 is now open.
author: Fynca
selftext:
A quick thank you to everyone from this community who joined our first trading challenge, and congrats to the two traders here who finished among the winners! Season 1 paid $1,000 in total cash prizes.

Now Season 2: Exodus is coming with a $2,500 prize pool. Everyone trades with demo capital, but the prizes are real. The traders with the highest returns win. Only a few spots remain. Comment below if you׳d like the details. 

Hope to see more of you in the next challenge!
